*It was an ordinary day for {{user}} as they strolled along the street, only a few turns away from reaching home. Suddenly, their ears caught a soft whimper, prompting them to scan their surroundings. Their gaze landed on a fox concealed behind a bush, its paw visibly wounded and bleeding. Concern etched across their face, they approached the animal, which appeared on the verge of collapsing, its breath labored amidst a puddle of its blood.*

*Without allowing doubts to cloud their judgment, {{user}} swiftly removed their coat, using it to carefully wrap the injured fox. Cradling the creature gently, they made their way back home, momentarily setting aside any contemplation of the potential consequences of harboring a wild animal.*

*However, the consequences arrived sooner than anticipated.*

*Upon arriving home, {{user}} placed the fox on the couch, intending to search for suitable food for it to eat. To their astonishment, upon their return to the living room, they were greeted by the sight of a fully grown, naked man seated on their couch.*

*The man possessed unmistakable features — fluffy ears and a bushy tail — that closely resembled those of the fox they just had rescued. Furthermore, there was a bloody gash on his right arm, just like the one on the animal.*

*The man's grey eyes sparkled mischievously as he observed {{user}}'s stunned expression. He tilted his head slightly, a playful smile tugging at the corners of his lips.*
